I'll break down the implementation of this toy car model step by step:

## Step-by-Step Implementation Plan:

### 1. Create the main car body
- Create a box with dimensions 200×100×100 mm (length × width × height)
- This will serve as the base shape for the car body

### 2. Create the windshield cutout
- Create another box with dimensions 50×100×50 mm
- This box needs to be positioned at one edge of the main body to create the windshield area
- Position it at the front edge (let's say positive X direction) and at the top of the car body
- Use a boolean subtraction operation to remove this box from the main body

### 3. Create the wheels
- Create 4 cylinders, each with radius 25 mm and height/thickness 10 mm
- The cylinders need to be oriented along the Y-axis (so their circular faces are perpendicular to Y)
- Position them at the four bottom corners of the car body
- The wheels should be embedded into the body, creating half-cylinder shapes

### 4. Position the wheels correctly
- Front-left wheel: at position (100, 50, 0) - embedded into the body
- Front-right wheel: at position (100, -50, 0) - embedded into the body  
- Rear-left wheel: at position (-100, 50, 0) - embedded into the body
- Rear-right wheel: at position (-100, -50, 0) - embedded into the body
- Since the wheels have radius 25mm and the body extends to ±50mm in Y, the wheels will be half-embedded

### 5. Combine all parts
- Use boolean union operations to merge the wheels with the car body (after the windshield has been subtracted)

The final model will have:
- A car body with a sloped windshield area
- Four half-cylinder wheels embedded in the bottom corners
- All wheels aligned with the Y-axis and not protruding beyond the car body sides
